title: FORGEOS
description: A local AI engineering operating system. One model, run through Ollama, follows a plan, act, observe, verify, and replan loop. Roles such as architect and QA are sequential policies, and the system checks evidence instead of trusting the model.

title: Nexus - Self-Evolving OS
description: Kernel work toward a hardware-adaptive operating system, codename Nexus. The long-term goal is a system that can propose, test, and deploy its own changes. The current milestone is V0.0.1, a small ARM64 kernel for QEMU and Raspberry Pi 5 that boots, isolates tasks, and recovers from failure. It is not an AI OS yet.

title: GenZSpace - Student Social Network
description: Student-only social network for Indian students, built with Flutter, Dart, and Firebase. The product idea is connect, share, and grow: a campus network that mixes social features with academic community.

title: ANU 6.0 - AI-Powered Humanoid Robot
description: AI-powered humanoid robot for rural education. Features 17 DOF, bilingual communication in Kannada and English, an offline-first design, and personalized learning paths. Built with Raspberry Pi 5, TensorFlow, OpenCV, and custom AI models.

title: KAVYA-AI
description: Kannada Academic Vision Yield AI. A pipeline that turns Kannada educational PDFs into structured Excel question banks, with OCR for scans, Kannada text cleanup, duplicate detection, and LLM correction.

title: GenZFlow
description: Company management platform for tasks, teams, and time. It covers task assignment, org charts, role-based analytics, and JWT authentication, with MongoDB and GitHub Actions deployment guides in the repo.

title: Coreline Studio
description: Mobile-first studio site for tattoo, drawing, and Zumba. Visitors book on WhatsApp. Built with Next.js, Supabase, and Vercel, with an admin inbox for orders, classes, and inquiries.

title: Eye Controlled Mouse
description: Eye-tracking mouse built with OpenCV and MediaPipe FaceMesh. Gaze moves the cursor. Blinks click, hold, drag, and scroll.

title: Maharaj Touchpad
description: Android Bluetooth remote that turns a phone into a trackpad and keyboard for Windows, including shortcuts, text selection, volume, and media keys.

title: AI Task Manager
description: Full-stack task manager with React, TypeScript, and FastAPI. Tasks support explain-with-AI and generate-an-implementation-plan actions through an OpenAI-compatible API.

title: NanoEpic
description: CPU-friendly pipeline for YouTube Shorts: idea, script, images, clips, voice, captions, and upload. Built for a machine without a GPU, using cloud models for text and images and local FFmpeg, Coqui, and Whisper for the rest.

title: FlowMind AI - Autonomous Marketing Assistant
description: AI-driven autonomous marketing platform built for HackAbhigna 2025. Features predictive analytics with Prophet, NLP insights with the Gemini API, CI/CD pipelines, Docker deployment, and integrations with YouTube, Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, and Google Search Console.

title: HealthCheckr - Website Monitoring Tool
description: Website uptime monitor with a status dashboard, email alerts, a background Python worker, PostgreSQL, and a Jenkins CI/CD pipeline. Packaged with Docker.

title: VisionGuard - Project Omega
description: Real-time crowd density and movement monitoring using ESP32-CAM, YOLOv5/v8, FastAPI, WebSockets, and LED alerts. Built to spot unsafe crowding in public spaces.

title: AI-Powered Fraud Detection System
description: Machine learning system for detecting fraudulent transactions. It uses anomaly detection and behavioral analysis for real-time prediction.

title: Anu AI - Personal AI Assistant
description: A personal AI assistant with vision and voice for PC and Android, built with TensorFlow, OpenCV, and Flask.

title: Choti Anu AI - IoT Assistant
description: A compact Anu AI for embedded boards such as the ESP32-CAM, with offline face recognition and conversation on the device.

title: AI Travel and Culture Guide
description: Travel itinerary generator powered by Gemini. It writes day-by-day plans with cultural notes, local recommendations, and export to JSON or text, and it ships with Docker.

title: SoulSync
description: Mind Companion and FutureYou in one project.

title: WhatsApp Auto
description: Automation for WhatsApp that processes resumes and streamlines communication workflows. Built with Node.js and Puppeteer.

title: Drowsiness Detection
description: Computer vision project for detecting drowsiness.

title: Traffic Management System
description: Traffic management system built for the E-Minds hackathon.

title: Meme Forge
description: Meme creation and social sharing web app.
